newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end steady on borrowing.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end steady on borrowing.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates ended steady on Tuesday amid a shortage of funds, dealers said.
The overnight rate was steady at 20 percent amid tight liquidity and banks discounted huge amounts with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP), a dealer at KASB & Co said.
He said term rates saw no change in dull trading as most borrowers were desperate to cover their overnight positions.
The SBP said it would hold its weekly open market operation on Thursday instead of Wednesday, which is a public holiday.
